repair.title: Nuclear Arsenals Shrunk
repair.summary: FAS estimates global nuclear weapons fell from about 70,300 in 1986 to about 12,321 at the start of 2026.
repair.why_it_matters: Arms control and post-Cold-War reductions show that even existential risks can be reduced.
repair.caveat: Modernization, treaty breakdown, and new arms races keep nuclear danger very real.
